hook: Anthropic CEO predicts *cancer, Alzheimer's, heart disease, mental illness* will be cured in less than 10 years
caption:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says AI could help cure cancer, Alzheimer's, heart disease and mental illness within a decade.

He has made this case before: AI applied to every stage of research could compress decades of medical progress into a few years. Critics say biology and clinical trials will not move that fast.

Do you believe it will happen in 10 years?
